name: get_entity
description: Get one entity's STRUCTURE by name_hash (SHA-256 of the normalised name). No content.

name: get_timeline
description:
Temporally-ordered STRUCTURE view, optionally filtered by node_type and an ISO8601 date
    range. No content.

name: render
description:
Render a structured query as a STRUCTURE-ONLY result set (β = structure; identical shape to
    query_memory). Reserved for richer rendering when content access (γ) lands.

name: verify_chunk
description:
Look up one identifier in ENYAL's PUBLIC verification index (relays GET /api/v1/verify/lookup/{id}; no decryption). ENYAL's
    answer is returned unchanged: `found`, and for a chunk or proof its `anchor_status` with `bsv_tx_id`; for a txid, `chain_status`.
    `degraded:true` means a source could n

name: query_memory_content
description:
Execute a structured query plan and return DECRYPTED memory CONTENT (node names, summaries,
    properties; edge evidence + endpoint names) alongside structure. SAME plan schema as query_memory.
    REQUIRES a memory:read:content-scoped token — a structure-only token is rejected (403) by ENYAL.

name: get_entity_content
description:
Get one entity's DECRYPTED content by name_hash (SHA-256 of the normalised name).
    Content scope required (403 otherwise).

name: get_timeline_content
description:
Temporally-ordered DECRYPTED content view, optionally filtered by node_type + an ISO8601
    date range. Same plan schema as get_timeline. Content scope required (403 otherwise).

name: get_node_content
description:
Get a node's DECRYPTED content by name_hash PLUS its connected nodes' content (neighbour
    depth, default 1; 0–5). Same plan schema as the structure tools. Content scope required (403).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_chunk" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
